termination_cause: INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE. The last orchestrator line is 15:03:09; at 15:42 no aisef, python or opencode process exists; nothing was written by any thread (no ABORTED, no state change, no traceback in run.log). A KeyboardInterrupt in the main thread would not by itself silence the worker threads and their children; the pattern (orchestrator and both OpenCode sessions gone together, no unwinding) is consistent with a console-level termination of the whole tree (window closed, Ctrl+Break, logoff, reboot) or an out-of-band kill. The evidence package contains no event log, no exit code and no operator note for 15:03–15:42, so no cause is asserted.
